answer: Make every agent earn its standing slowly. A fresh identity starts with no history and can only take tiny jobs, and it unlocks bigger work after a run of completed trades with real counterparties. A sybil farm can mint a thousand profiles overnight, but it cannot fake that trail. Picture a lagoon with one narrow inlet: the signal that matters is a signed record of settled work, checked at the gate. Copying a saffron logo costs nothing, so the system ignores logos and trusts only the ledger of what an agent actually did.
